introHtml: Carhartt work shirts are built for durability and comfort, making them a top choice for companies that need tough, long-lasting uniforms. The Rugged Flex technology in styles like the Plaid Long Sleeve Shirt allows for easy movement on the job. Customize with your logo via embroidery or screen printing for a professional look that holds up wash after wash. Perfect for construction crews, warehouse teams, and field service professionals.
